Memonta 9.5.2（142）
- 修复进入全屏后关闭主窗口，留下仅菜单栏可见的黑色全屏 Space 的问题。 - 关闭或从菜单栏隐藏全屏窗口时，先退出全屏，等待系统完成后再隐藏；窗口继续保留，可从菜单栏或 Dock 恢复。 - 处理全屏进入/退出途中关闭，以及隐藏后立即重新显示的竞争情况，避免迟到回调再次隐藏窗口。 - 退出全屏失败时保留窗口并允许重试；隐藏全部窗口后再隐藏 Dock。
验证：450 项单元测试通过；使用真实 AppKit 窗口验证全屏关闭、普通最大化关闭、进入全屏途中关闭、菜单栏隐藏、恢复与快速重新显示。
English
- Fixes a black full-screen Space remaining after closing the main window in full-screen mode. - Exits full screen before hiding the window, preserving the same window for restoration from the menu bar or Dock. - Handles close and restore requests during full-screen transitions, preventing delayed callbacks from hiding a restored window. - Keeps the window available if exiting full screen fails, and hides the Dock only after all windows have finished hiding.
Validation: 450 unit tests passed, plus native AppKit window lifecycle checks. Like 9.5.1, this release is not notarized by Apple; initial installation may be blocked by macOS and system permissions may need to be granted again.
此版本未经 Apple 公证，仅用于用户已同意的更新测试；首次安装可能被系统阻止，系统权限可能需要重新授予。
